about.title: About
paragraphs: I work as a Senior General QA Engineer: functional testing, UI, API, automation, and test documentation.
My current stack is TypeScript and Playwright for UI, API, and E2E tests. I started automation with Java, Selenium, Maven, and REST Assured.
I have FinTech experience on a B2B payment platform, in the Access & Identity team: access, accounts, roles, and corporate client operations.
On my last project I was the first QA: I set up the process, docs, and regression, then automation and CI/CD.
I care about a framework the team can trust in CI, fewer flaky tests, and shorter manual regression.

now.title: Now
now.body: I am preparing for interviews: Playwright, API, SQL, and how I explain the framework and Jenkins. Short notes and spoken answers live on separate pages.
